system: Synergy CNN, Cantori, Mari, Vitali, Pilati, EPJ Quantum Technology 11, 45 (2024)
phase: 1 of 3, ACQUIRE. No arm was fitted.

scoped_experiment.figure: journal Fig. 7 and Fig. 8 (same test cases); arXiv v1 Fig. 7. Files are named Fig8*.
scoped_experiment.shot_grid_verified: all z_noisy values are exact multiples of 2/10^4

target_column.definition: mz = (1/N) sum_n <psi_out| Z_n |psi_out>, exact average magnetization per qubit, from state-vector simulation (paper Eq. 5)
target_column.determinism_argument: The ideal circuit is fixed by theta given q, the RZZ angle phi=-pi/2, the Guadalupe connectivity and |0>^N. q is constant across every released row. The target is computed by StatevectorEstimator on the untranspiled logical circuit, so it carries no shot noise and no transpilation dependence. Therefore mz_exact = f(theta) exactly.

qubits.note: paper normalizes as q' = q/10; zero variance in the released rows, so it carries no information for any arm fitted on them

z_noisy.definition: noisy single-qubit <Z_n> from the FakeGuadalupe simulation at 10^4 shots

mz_zne.definition: Richardson ZNE (Mitiq, lambda=1,2,3) applied to the noisy values; a released baseline, never an arm input

mz_linear.definition: released affine baseline, mz = c1*mz_noisy + c2 (paper text); reads an execution-derived input, so it is NOT arm A

mz_predicted.definition: released prediction of the hybrid CNN(theta, q, z_noisy), trained on Ktrain ~ 6e5 circuits with N<=10; this is arm F

device_calibration.reason: The release ships no gate-error, t1, t2 or readout vector. Noise enters only through the static FakeGuadalupe model, and q, the sole device-position descriptor, is constant across every released row. There is nothing to make available to A and C in one scoring and withhold in the other.
device_calibration.consequence: S2 is scored once, not twice. This follows from the release contents and was recorded before any fit.

refit_status.reason: Ktrain ~ 6e5 training circuits (N<=10) are absent from the Zenodo record, from every GitHub tag 1.0-1.4, and from every blob in the repository's full history. circ_gen.py is a generator stub (num_samples=1) requiring qiskit-aer simulation, which is a recipe to regenerate rather than released training material. cnn_2D.py releases the configuration-B architecture only; the configuration-A 1D variant used for panel a is not released.
refit_status.governing_clause: PLAN 'Where a system cannot be refitted': F is the released prediction; A and C are fitted on the released rows under a declared split; the reduced scope is stated in the same sentence as the result.

split_structure.released_split: none for the arms. All 300 released rows are test rows for the released model.
split_structure.row_shuffled_argument: One row is one circuit realization. theta rows are 100/100 unique within every panel, Fig8b and Fig8c share zero theta rows, and no target value is shared between any two panels. A row-shuffled split therefore cannot place rows of the same circuit on both sides, so PLAN leak check 4's specific hazard does not arise.

declared_asymmetries_recorded_before_fit.name: training-budget gap
declared_asymmetries_recorded_before_fit.detail: F carries ~6e5 training circuits; A and C get at most 100 rows minus the split.
declared_asymmetries_recorded_before_fit.bias_direction: inflates T = A - F, biases S DOWNWARD, favours reading ABSENT

declared_asymmetries_recorded_before_fit.name: test-size transfer gap
declared_asymmetries_recorded_before_fit.detail: F was trained at N<=10 and transferred to N=16; A and C would be fitted directly at N=16.
declared_asymmetries_recorded_before_fit.bias_direction: biases S UPWARD, favours reading PRESENT

1_target_not_in_features.evidence: mz_exact equals no column of theta, qubits or z_noisy at 1e-9, and does not equal mean(z_noisy) (max abs diff 0.4025 / 0.2376 / 0.1139 by panel). mz_zne, mz_linear and mz_predicted are other methods' outputs and are excluded from every arm's feature set.

2_no_oracle_quantity.evidence: No released input carries an ideal quantity. mz_zne is Richardson extrapolation over noisy executions, not an oracle. No evaluation case is filtered by any ideal quantity: all 100 rows per panel are present and unfiltered. The S3-specific exclusions do not apply here.

3_row_count_and_schema.evidence: 21 .npy asserted and found; every one of the 21 shapes matched the pre-declared expectation; Zenodo MD5 matched the record.

corroboration_of_identity.note: The released arrays reproduce the journal's reported scores exactly, which confirms mz_predicted is the hybrid CNN and mz_linear is the paper's linear scheme.

authors_own_descriptor_only_arm.model: CNN(theta, q), two input channels, cnn_2D.py CNN(synergy=False)
authors_own_descriptor_only_arm.paper_result_config_B: fails to reach reasonable accuracies R2 ~ 1, even with as many as Ktrain ~ 1e6 training circuits (Fig. 5)
authors_own_descriptor_only_arm.training_budget_of_that_claim: 1e6 circuits, four orders of magnitude above the 100 released rows

decisions_phase_2_must_declare_before_fi: Whether the three panels are scored separately or as one S2 verdict. Recommendation: separately, because configuration A and configuration B are different circuit families, p_noise differs between b and c, each panel's mz_predicted comes from a separately trained CNN, and the authors' own descriptor-only arm succeeds on A and fails on B. Pooling would average over the distinction that decides the question.

The scalar performance measure per arm, and that A, C and F are all evaluated on the SAME held-out rows within each draw. F's released predictions exist on every row, so restricting F to the held-out subset keeps the comparison on identical rows.
The resample unit (the circuit, that is the row) and the bootstrap count, both before fitting.

Whether a matched-budget refitted F (a hybrid theta+q+z_noisy model fitted on the same <=100 rows as A and C) is reported alongside released-F. The plan mandates released-F here and encourages reporting any released-vs-refitted gap; the matched-budget refit is the only construction in which T is not confounded by the training-budget gap. Declare before fitting, report both, reconcile neither.
That constant columns (all 16 of qubits) are dropped for rank reasons in the affine arm. This is a mechanical necessity, not feature selection.
saturation_note_for_phase_3: Information-theoretic saturation is 1.0 by construction: the target is an exact deterministic function of the released descriptors. Any low measured saturation on these 100 rows is a statement about learning a 16- or 20-dimensional function from 100 samples, not about the descriptors lacking the information. The report must not convert it into the plan's 'descriptors never carried the information' branch.
